SELECT nextval('sys_logininfor_info_id_seq'::regclass) as infoId
insert into sys_logininfor (info_id,user_name, status, ipaddr, login_location, browser, os, msg, login_time, tenant_id) values (#{infoId}, #{userName}, #{status}, #{ipaddr}, #{loginLocation}, #{browser}, #{os}, #{msg}, now(), #{tenantId})
mapper.select:
select info_id, user_name, ipaddr, login_location, browser, os, status, msg, login_time, tenant_id from sys_logininfor
AND ipaddr like concat(concat('%', #{ipaddr}), '%')
AND status = #{status}
AND user_name like concat(concat('%', #{userName}), '%')
and login_time >= to_date(#{beginTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
and login_time <= to_date(#{endTime},'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
order by info_id desc
